question.problem:
Expressed as a single fraction, the exact area of the plot of land is$\,${{field-1}}
hectares.
question.worked_solution:
The exact area of land is ${(\frac{7}{9})}^{2}$ hectares.

Writing ${(\frac{7}{9})}^{2}$ with multiplication signs, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\frac{7}{9})}^{2} & ={{\frac{7}{9}\times \frac{7}{9}}_{⏟}}_{2\text{ times}} \\  & =\frac{7\times 7}{9\times 9} \\  & =\frac{49}{81}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
{(\frac{7}{9})}^{2}=\frac{49}{81}.
$$
